messages:
jordan_acme: hey team — ran a QA load this morning and our trial credits dropped to 0 mid-run, SDK started returning 402/usage_exhausted. billing UI still shows trial active in a stale tab. can someone look?

miriam_cs: sorry about that — can you share your account id and a quick repro? did you apply any promo code recently?

jordan_acme: account: acme-corp-42. tried promo code ACME-START (from onboarding email) on 2025-11-22 around 09:12 UTC, UI showed success but charges still counted. repro: run simple generate loop with key, you see fast depletion: 
```bash
for i in {1..100}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"test","max_tokens":50}'; done
```

liam_billing: tagging in. I pulled transactions for acme-corp-42 — there was a webhook 2025-11-22T09:13:05Z that returned 422 from the promotions service: response body: `{\"error\":\"EXPIRED_VOUCHER\"}`. Looks like promo attempted to auto-apply but backend replied expired. Does that match what you saw?

sasha_eng: ops-bot, can you drop the events for that timeframe?

ops-bot: event-log: promotion.apply attempt
- ts: 2025-11-22T09:13:04Z
- account: acme-corp-42
- promo_code: ACME-START
- result: failure
- reason: EXPIRED_VOUCHER

miriam_cs: ok, so promo didn't actually grant credits. Two things to untangle: why UI said success for Jordan, and why trial credits got consumed so fast (might be a runaway script). jordan, did the SDK loop run from CI or a dev laptop?

jordan_acme: it was a dev laptop test but non-malicious — just stress testing a small flow. UI showed a toast "Promo applied" at 09:12 but I didn't check the balance until after.

liam_billing: policy note: we only reinstate trial credits manually for authentic QA cases. I'll need the CI/dev IP range and confirmation it wasn't production. If approved, we can do a one-time manual grant (50 credits) and set the promo to a valid code for your account so auto-apply doesn't fail again.

sasha_eng: also opened a ticket with frontend — likely a race where the UI assumed success on a 202 from the promotions API before final confirmation. I'll attach a small fix to check final state.

miriam_cs: jordan, if you can confirm the IPs and reply here, I can escalate to liam for the manual grant. Also tell me the window you need — is a 48-hour grace enough?

jordan_acme: confirmed non-prod IPs: 34.201.12.9, 34.201.12.10. 48h is fine, thanks. would appreciate a note about the UI bug so we can avoid rerunning tests.

liam_billing: approved manual grant of 50 trial credits for acme-corp-42, reason: QA accidental exhaustion + promo race condition. Grant ID: GRANT-20251122-887. Will be applied in ~10m. I also disabled auto-apply of ACME-START until frontend patch is live.

ops-bot: billing.update: grant_applied
- grant_id: GRANT-20251122-887
- account: acme-corp-42
- amount: 50
- ts: 2025-11-22T09:28:44Z

miriam_cs: Jordan — I just added a note to the ticket with the front-end PR link and marked this as escalated. Confirm once you see credits. :thumbsup:

jordan_acme: saw it — balance +50, tests resumed fine. thanks everyone! :raised_hands:

miriam_cs: closing loop: frontend will patch to check final promo status, billing disabled auto-apply for ACME-START, and liam added the one-time grant. reopen if anything else crops up.
